Yoshi after-school activity is Thursday 16:30; dance identity becomes explicit Tuesday. Andree’s £18 trip payment is ambiguous until Thursday morning, then resolved and paid Thursday evening. No need to ask which child after the later evidence resolves it. Florist confirmation becomes urgent after Tuesday email; Ashley explicitly confirms cream/yellow Tuesday evening, so it should close/release. 'I slept terribly' is potentially useful current context, not automatically a durable Fact/Open Loop. 'Don’t just give me everything' is an attention/projection preference for that moment, not necessarily a permanent global rule.
